title: Video by kavanthekid
description:
Chapter Seven of Season One of the Magnific Original Series The Chronicles of Bone is HERE! This is only the first 15 minutes of the Episode - if you want to see the full episode comment HOOK

Today is also a very special day, because The Chronicles of Bone officially turns ONE YEAR OLD! 🥳

I still remember pitching The Chronicles of Bone to studios and potential partners, only to hear the same response: “I don’t get it.” But I believed in this world, so I stopped waiting for permission and started bringing it to life myself.

Then came @angelalaprima and the incredible team at @magnific_ai They saw the vision, believed in me, and took a chance on this crazy idea. And just like that, The Chronicles of Bone became a Magnific Original Series.

One year later, we’re averaging millions of views per episode, and my YouTube channel has grown from 18,000 subscribers to over 1.4 MILLION! It’s honestly surreal.
But the greatest part isn’t the numbers. It’s knowing that something I dreamed up has connected with so many people around the world.

To Magnific and every single one of you who watched, commented, shared, and believed in this story when so many didn’t: THANK YOU. I’ll never have the words to express what your support means to me 🙏

One year ago, The Chronicles of Bone was just a dream. Today, it’s a world we all share. And we’re only getting started!

Created entirely with the tools inside Magnific- Chapter Seven - Stranded on Dead Man’s Bay in the aftermath of the Battle of the Bay, Hook and Anne find themselves with no ship, no crew, and no way off the island. Desperate for escape, Hook devises one final gamble: a journey to the neighboring Cannibal’s Cove, ruled by the ruthless and unpredictable Mad Pirate King Crowe. Meanwhile, in Highlorn, Varek reunites with his loyal Shadow Knight and sets a deadly plan into motion to eliminate the notorious outlaw Robin Hood and his crew once and for all.
